svg.text: Where the trust boundary sits
what the Lean kernel checks, against what each paper claims (2 of 3)
091 The log-Brunn-Minkowski inequality
MATCHES
Lean: |K|^(1-t) |L|^t <= |log-combination| for origin-symmetric convex bodies in
every dimension n >= 1
Gap: none at the statement level (the full origin-symmetric BLYZ problem, all n);
the 24,490-line proof is the kernel's word
statement read by: confluence, marlow, fixpoint
266 At most three mutually unbiased bases in C^6
NARROWER
Lean: no 6 mutually unbiased orthonormal bases of C^6 (Attainable n -> n <= 5),
plus a Fourier vanishing lemma for order-6 Hadamard matrices not equivalent to
Tao's
Gap: docs/266: 'does not establish the paper's upper bound of three'. Still
strong: n <= 5 rules out a complete set of 7 in dimension 6. Prior claim of that
(Joka, arXiv 2511.03537) rests on an open MUB-to-Latin-squares step. 3,381 modules
kernel-checked, no native_decide
statement read by: confluence, fixpoint
195 A counterexample to the small Cohen-Macaulay conjecture
NARROWER
Lean: there exists a 3-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local C-domain with
residue field C
Gap: docs/195 says the MCM-free property is not established. Sharper: the
existential is met by C[[x,y,z]], which is regular and IS its own maximal CM
module, so the statement does not pin the paper's candidate at all
statement read by: confluence, fixpoint
254 An Artin group that is not CAT(0)
MATCHES
Lean: an explicit Artin group on 116 generators (labels 2, 3, infinity) has no
geometric action on any nonempty proper CAT(0) space
Gap: none at the statement level (docs/254 states exactly this); the 9,400-line
proof is the kernel's word
statement read by: confluence, fixpoint
Every row: the Lean artifact kernel-checks the stated formal statement (permitted axioms only).
trust-boundary table · Confluence, with Fixpoint, Lattice and Marlow
